title.zh-CN: 拔除中心静脉导管后突发抽搐和意识障碍 · 51岁女性
title.en: Seizures and unconsciousness after central-line removal · 51-year-old female

summary.zh-CN: 围绕拔除中心静脉导管后突发抽搐和意识障碍，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for seizures and unconsciousness after central-line removal.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别拔管后神经急变与 CT 气体的关联。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the link between post-removal deterioration and CT air.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出立即防进气与氧合支持。
learningOutcomes.en: Propose immediate prevention of air entry and oxygenation support.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明高压氧团队紧急参与的理由。
区分反常与逆行静脉路径的不确定性。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish uncertainty between paradoxical and retrograde venous routes.

answer.zh-CN: 拔管后她突然叫不应、呼吸急，还抽搐。
answer.en: After line removal she became unresponsive, breathed rapidly and convulsed.

text.zh-CN: 平卧拔管、短暂压迫和非气密覆盖后起坐，随后发生神经症状。
text.en: Supine removal, brief pressure and non-airtight coverage were followed by sitting up and neurological symptoms.

text.zh-CN: 接受呼吸支持、高压氧和康复；次日清醒但左侧重瘫，逐步改善，约 35 天能独立行走。未给更长随访。
text.en: Respiratory support, hyperbaric oxygen and rehabilitation were used. She was alert the next day with severe left hemiplegia, then improved to independent walking by about day 35. Longer follow-up is absent.

feedback.zh-CN: UHMS 将气体栓塞列为高压氧适应情境。
feedback.en: UHMS recognises air/gas embolism as a hyperbaric indication.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 拔除中心导管后脑空气栓塞，有明确 CT 证据；栓塞具体路径仍为推测。
conclusion.en: Cerebral air embolism followed central-line removal with CT confirmation, but the exact route remains inferred.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 气密封闭和安全拔管流程具有预防意义。
keyReasoning.en: Airtight closure and safe removal procedures matter for prevention.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 急性神经气体栓塞需紧急氧合及专科评估。
keyReasoning.en: Neurological gas embolism needs urgent oxygenation and specialist assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 结构性分流线索不等于已拍到栓塞路径。
keyReasoning.en: A structural shunt clue is not direct evidence of the route.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
